notes.peak_int8_theory: 16 Zen5 cores @ ~3.1 GHz x 2 512-bit VNNI pipes x 64 int8 MACs/vpdpbusd x 2 ops/MAC ~= 12.7 TOPS envelope (theoretical only, NOT measured); implied utilization ~28-37%
notes.a2_accounting: ComfyUI A2 counters: 13,891,534,848 B dequant per encode from results/comfy_cpu/runtime_path.md; int8 payload 8,190,427,136 and embed/lm_head 622,329,856 verified from the safetensors header (cited in README.md / report/RESULTS.md); A2 latencies 12.98/13.73/15.43 s are run2 warm_means (run1-3 means 12.93/13.60/15.44 -> implied 2.7/2.6/2.3 GB/s, same conclusions)
notes.rss: OV bridge peak RSS 14.57-15.1 GiB (u8 weights 8.2 GiB + runtime scratch/allocator); ComfyUI A2 peak 7.59 GiB
notes.assumptions: Implied GB/s assume each weight byte is touched exactly once per encode (ideal streaming; copy-B repack caches ignored); real DRAM bandwidth NOT measured (perf blocked)
